description:
The facts of an item an agent (or you) can set. In `items.edit` a field left out (or `null`) is left as it is; to empty a field, or hand it back to what flux finds by itself, name it in `clear`. In `item.get` every field is listed with its value now (`null` when empty or withheld).

Field names (for `clear`, `sources` and `withheld`) are these keys, and `ids.<provider>` for one id (`ids.tmdb`).

cast.description: Top-billed cast, in billing order (at most 100).

role.description: The part they play, or what they do ("Narrator", "Herself").

content_rating.description: A rating such as `PG-13`, `12`, `TV-MA`, with no country prefix.

countries.description: Countries of production, as ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes (`JP`, `FR`).

ids.description: Ids in other databases, by provider: `tmdb` (number), `imdb` (`tt…`), `tvdb` (number), `wikidata` (`Q…`), or any other (`anidb`, `musicbrainz`, `letterboxd`, …). In `items.edit` the ids given are added or replaced; the others stay. With a metadata provider configured, ids you set make flux match by id instead of by title.

languages.description: Spoken languages, as ISO 639-1 codes where one exists (`ja`, `en`, `zh-Hant`).

links.description: Pages worth keeping with it: official site, encyclopaedia entries, an archive page, the festival listing.

items.description: A web page or file that supports a value, or a link to keep. In an input, a plain URL string is read as a link without a title.

original_title.description: The title in its original language and script (`千と千尋の神隠し`), when it differs. Search finds both.

overview.description: What it's about, two to five sentences, in your own words: never copied from a provider (and never from TMDB).

tagline.description: A one-line hook, if it has a well-known one.

tags.description: Your own labels, for collections and search: `["Studio Ghibli", "Concert", "Festival short"]`.

title.description: The title to show: the film's or show's best-known title in the library's language, the season's name, the episode's title.

year.description: The year of first release (a show's first season).

title: Fields
